name: Captain Danuvin
summary: Captain Danuvin is an officer stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall, serving as one of the leaders tasked with holding the frontier together. Working alongside the People's Militia, he directs volunteers and recruits to patrol the roads and push back against encroaching Gnolls and outlaws. His commands are vital to keeping the supply lines and farmlands from falling completely into hostile hands.

sections.title: Holding the Hill
sections.body: Perched at the fortified tower of Sentinel Hill, Captain Danuvin coordinates ground patrols across Westfall. The region has spiraled into chaos with the withdrawal of regular Stormwind garrison troops, leaving local defenses severely depleted. Danuvin relies heavily on wandering adventurers, local farmhands, and volunteer fighters to maintain even a semblance of order across the grassy plains.

sections.title: Patrolling the Frontier
sections.body: Danuvin's immediate strategic concern is the security of the roadways and open lands around Sentinel Hill. With the Riverpaw Gnolls growing bolder and raiding close to central outposts, he organizes active patrols to cull their packs and secure the perimeter. His orders help prevent the encampment from being entirely surrounded by Westfall's opportunists and marauders.

faq.q: Where can I find Captain Danuvin?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin is stationed at Sentinel Hill, the primary Alliance outpost located in central Westfall. He is usually found standing near the hill's fortified tower overlooking the road.

faq.q: What faction does Captain Danuvin represent?
faq.answer: Danuvin serves the Alliance and works directly in support of the local defense forces in Westfall, collaborating closely with Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia.

faq.q: What duties does he assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Danuvin tasks recruits with securing the countryside, primarily through orders like patrolling the plains and driving back the aggressive Riverpaw Gnoll packs encroaching on Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: Why is Danuvin relying on volunteers instead of the Stormwind Army?
faq.answer: Stormwind's royal court has refused to commit official garrison troops to defend Westfall, citing budget shortfalls and political discord. Danuvin and the rest of the leadership at Sentinel Hill have no choice but to rely on mercenaries and militia recruits.

faq.q: Does Danuvin have connections outside of Westfall?
faq.answer: Danuvin's ties are to Westfall itself. It is his homeland, and he has vowed not to turn his back on the citizens who chose to remain, so his duties keep him focused on the plains and roads around Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: What is his role compared to Gryan Stoutmantle?
faq.answer: While Gryan Stoutmantle oversees the broad defense strategy and leadership of the People's Militia, Captain Danuvin acts as a field officer managing tactical concerns, road patrols, and the immediate gnoll threat around the base.

angles.text: Captain Danuvin represents one of the few standing military figures striving to uphold order in Westfall despite the crown's neglect, offering Alliance recruits steady work defending the realm.
Danuvin respects martial discipline and direct frontline action, valuing warriors who are willing to charge into gnoll packs and clear the highway through brute strength.
For humans of the kingdom, assisting Danuvin is a matter of homeland survival, ensuring the breadbasket of Stormwind is not permanently lost to raiders and beasts.
